title: ARIA Skill v1
description: Frontmatter schema for ARIA Core SKILL.md files. Extends the agentskills.io v2026-03 spec with ARIA-specific governance fields (owner, version, dossier requirements, multi-agent chain metadata). Authority: ITECHDEV-MX/aria-core.

name.description: Stable skill identifier. Must match the parent directory name. Lowercase letters/digits with single hyphens; no leading, trailing, or doubled hyphens.

description.description: One-paragraph summary used by the skill ranker.

compatibility.description: Free-text compatibility notes (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).

metadata.description: Free key/value bag for non-schema-validated tags.

allowed-tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL (agentskills.io). Space-separated tool allowlist for the agent invoking this skill.

version.description: Semver. Major bumps required for breaking changes.

owner.description: Skill maintainer email. F1.a: enforced by PR review convention. F1.b: must match an entry in aria_skill_maintainers.

expertise_domains.description: Hint for PR auto-routing — does NOT restrict who can approve in F1.a. Examples: ['cotizador', 'kb', 'mcp'].

last_reviewed.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the last maintainer review.

supersedes.description: Names of older skills this one replaces.

agent.description: When true, this skill is invoked as a sub-agent in a multi-agent chain (e.g. story-creation pipeline). When false, it's a rule set the calling agent applies in-context.

position_in_chain.description: 0-indexed position in a multi-agent chain. Only meaningful when agent=true. The orchestrator uses this to order invocations.

required_artifacts.description: Filenames the orchestrator must provide before invoking.

aria_page_template.description: Template name in aria_pages for cloud mirroring.
